query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT name, id FROM users WHERE (name = $1) AND (id < $3) AND ($3 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT name, id FROM users WHERE (name = $1) AND ($3 IS NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $4 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN user_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
